purpose: Development-only paired nuisance and observation-cadence controls before adaptation
old_test_policy: Original v1 test and consumed v2 holdout are excluded from fitting and selection; initial layouts only may be read to reject duplicates

nuisance.comparison: one factor at a time against reference arm, open gripper, zero camera shift
nuisance.validity: target and all nonrobot object poses fixed exactly; target support and no finger contact required; visibility counted by evaluator-only segmentation
nuisance.limitation: static rendered interventions; segmentation is a visibility proxy, not semantic recognition proof

temporal.limitation: dense means evaluation every physical control with the same three-frame model, not a newly trained eleven-frame architecture

stop_probe.action: hold current arm pose and open gripper
stop_probe.type: simulator branch from first claimed-complete state

adaptation.validation_selection: first require event gates, then minimize premature/missed/post-stop/delay violations; no independent test until development gate passes

independent_acceptance: not included in these development controls; requires another unused holdout after development passes
